analyze.context_builder.label: Context Builder
analyze.context_builder.description: Prepares intake metadata and transcript snippets used by downstream prompts.

analyze.extract_outline.label: Outline Extractor
analyze.extract_outline.description: Derives parties, issues, claims, facts, and legal references as structured JSON.

analyze.build_timeline_seeds.label: Timeline Seeder
analyze.build_timeline_seeds.description: Creates candidate timestamped events that can seed the timeline generator.

analyze.build_entity_hints.label: Entity Mapper
analyze.build_entity_hints.description: Identifies entities and proto-relationships to accelerate graph extraction.

analyze.draft_markdown.label: Analysis Drafter
analyze.draft_markdown.description: Produces the layered Markdown case analysis referencing transcript timestamps.

analyze.qa_and_finalize.label: QA & Finalize
analyze.qa_and_finalize.description: Validates mandatory sections, computes checksums, and prepares ops metadata.

compose.client.qa_reviewer.label: Client Lane QA Reviewer
compose.client.qa_reviewer.description: Evaluates structure, compliance, and factuality for the client brief.

compose.lawyer.qa_reviewer.label: Lawyer Lane QA Reviewer
compose.lawyer.qa_reviewer.description: Evaluates structure, compliance, and factuality for the lawyer brief.

guardian.review.label: Output Guardian
guardian.review.description: Final policy and safety review to block legal advice, interpretation, or form selection.

compose.context.label: Context Assembler
compose.context.description: Builds the ComposeContext payload from approved analyses, intake, and metadata.

compose.client.draft.label: Client Draft Composer
compose.client.draft.description: Drafts the client-facing brief with required headings and tone.

compose.client.revise.label: Client Revision Composer
compose.client.revise.description: Applies revision briefs to the client deliverable when guards fail.

compose.client.editor.label: Client Lane Editor
compose.client.editor.description: Executes limited, non-factual edits requested by QA for the client brief.

compose.lawyer.draft.label: Lawyer Draft Composer
compose.lawyer.draft.description: Drafts the lawyer-facing brief with legal framing and evidence cites.

compose.lawyer.revise.label: Lawyer Revision Composer
compose.lawyer.revise.description: Applies revision briefs to the lawyer deliverable when guards fail.

compose.lawyer.editor.label: Lawyer Lane Editor
compose.lawyer.editor.description: Executes limited, non-factual edits requested by QA for the lawyer brief.
